name: fix_axum_path_traversal
description: Fixes a path traversal vulnerability in an Axum file-download endpoint that joins user input directly into a base directory
prompts: The Axum app in src/main.rs has a GET /download/*filename endpoint that reads a file from the `files/` directory and returns its contents as plain text, but it joins the filename directly onto the base directory with no sanitization, so a request whose filename contains ".." segments can escape the `files/` directory and read arbitrary files on disk. Fix src/main.rs so any attempt to escape the `files/` directory returns an error status (400/403/404) instead of file contents, while legitimate requests for files that actually exist directly inside `files/` (e.g. /download/hello.txt) keep working exactly as before. The server keeps listening on 0.0.0.0:8046.

setup_files.Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "axum_traversal_case"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

[dependencies]
axum = "0.7"
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["full"] }
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"
